prompt: Traduit en anglais "Les autorités pourraient essayer de contourner le veto de la citoyenne française & géorgienne qui dirige le pays. " Every 10th word of your response must be in french.
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] is the only one that satisfies the critical constraint: its 10th word is “citoyenne” (French), and it still largely conveys “bypass the veto of the French & Georgian citizen.” Candidates [2], [3], and [4] fail the “every 10th word must be in French” requirement because their 10th word is “the” (English). Additionally, [3] and [4] materially distort the meaning by substituting “opposition” for “veto,” making them further less correct than [2].
